name: DodgePrint
description:
DodgePrint is the central hub for automated print-on-demand, trusted by 2,000+ sellers running shops on Etsy, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Shopify. 

This connector brings DodgePrint's Etsy intelligence and more features directly into Claude

_published_faq.name: How do I add DodgePrint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DodgePrint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.dodgeprint.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DodgePrint MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DodgePrint provides these MCP tools: analyze_competition, benchmark_listing, explore_niche, find_niche_hidden_gems, find_shared_keywords, how_to_use, plan_seasonal_calendar, research_keyword, research_shop, scout_new_winners, scout_opportunities, and suggest_tags.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DodgePrint?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DodgePrint in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
DodgePrint requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DodgePrint is developed by Dodge Print. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
